GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.

2. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Haus
   B. Buch
   C. Wasser
   D. Schule

3. When practising Listening for details Presentation skills., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for details Presentation skills..
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for details Presentation skills..
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for details Presentation skills..
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Presentation skills..

   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information Conversational Skills.

7. When practising Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.

8. When practising Extensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading.

9. When practising ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.

10. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Please
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Good night

11. When practising Active listening Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
